stays.name: The Don CeSar
stays.summary: A beachfront resort hotel at the south end of St. Pete Beach that opened in 1928 and calls itself the Pink Palace. It closed for repairs after Hurricanes Helene and Milton in fall 2024 and reopened in March 2025.
stays.quote: Perched atop the windswept dunes of St. Pete Beach, The Don CeSar, since its inception in 1928, stands as a shining monument of glamor and leisure.

heritage.story: Developer Thomas Rowe opened the Don Ce-Sar on January 16, 1928. During World War II the Army bought the hotel and reopened it as a military hospital in December 1942; from February 1944 it was a convalescent center for the Army Air Corps, and by the end of 1945 it housed a Veterans Administration regional office. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places on April 3, 1975.
heritage.visiting: It operates as a resort hotel with restaurants, a spa and pools; the hotel is a member of Historic Hotels of America.

stays.notes: Closed for hurricane repairs Sep 2024 to Mar 2025 (HVS, Jul 1, 2026; Wikipedia). Room count not stated on the hotel's site (Wikipedia: 277 rooms and 40 suites; Visit St. Pete-Clearwater: 277 rooms and 36 suites), left null. NPS NRIS lists the architect as unknown; Wikipedia names Henry H. Dupont.

stays.name: Beach House Suites by The Don CeSar
stays.summary: An all-suite sister property of The Don CeSar, half a mile up the beach, with kitchenettes, a heated pool and pool bar, and a shuttle to The Don. It shared The Don CeSar's hurricane closure from September 2024 to March 2025.
stays.quote: Our coastal cool Beach House Suites combine all the benefits of a vacation rental with all the luxury amenities of a resort.
stays.notes: Quote begins 'Just a half mile up the beach from the legendary Pink Palace® itself, our coastal cool…' on the page; capitalized here.

stays.name: Island Grand at TradeWinds

stays.quote: Island Grand at TradeWinds is the perfect place for your entire crew to just let go and enjoy all the sun and fun Florida has to offer.
stays.notes: Page lists '381 Rooms + Villas' (rooms left null because the figure combines rooms and villas). HVS (Jul 2026): undergoing Phase I of a multi-year renovation.

stays.name: RumFish Beach at TradeWinds

stays.notes: Page lists '352 Rooms + Villas' (rooms left null). The former Alden Suites URL (aldenbeachresort.com, tradewindsresort.com/rumfish/alden-suites) now redirects to this page.

stays.name: The Beachcomber Beach Resort & Hotel

report:
## stays-beaches — Gulf beach lodging, Clearwater Beach to Tierra Verde (checked Sep 27, 2026)

**Covered:** 134 stays records (128 open, 6 temporarily closed) on the Pinellas barrier islands.
By area: treasure-island 35, clearwater-beach 33, st-pete-beach 30, indian-rocks-beach 17 (incl. Indian Shores, Redington Shores, North Redington Beach), pass-a-grille 7, madeira-beach 7, sand-key 3 (Sand Key, Belleair Beach), fort-de-soto 2 (Tierra Verde).
By kind: motel 40, condo-hotel 24, resort 23, hotel 18, boutique-hotel 14, inn 11, extended-stay 3, historic-hotel 1 (The Don CeSar, with a heritage block: NRHP 75000563, 1975).
Temporarily closed (kept because visitors will look for them): Bellwether Beach Resort (own site), Thunderbird Beach Resort (HVS, Jul 2026), Tahitian Beach Resort (own site: "closed for repairs"), Trade Winds Motel TI, Sunburst Inn, Treasure Shores Beach Club (all three flagged "temporarily closed" on Visit St. Pete-Clearwater).
Hurricane reopenings recorded with sources: Don CeSar and Beach House Suites (Sep 2024–Mar 2025), Beachcomber (Oct 2025), Belleair Beach Resort Motel (Feb 2026), Sails Resort Motel (Mar 2026), Holiday Isles, Hideaway Sands, Sea Chest, Arvilla, Oasis Palms, Sunset Inn & Cabanas (own sites say reopened/open), Postcard Inn reopened as The Luce (Jun 2026).

**How candidates were found:** (1) the Tampa Bay Beaches Chamber accommodations directory (business.tampabaybeaches.com, 120 member pages scraped for address/phone/website/description); (2) the Visit St. Pete-Clearwater sitemap (every /profile/ slug on pages 2–3) plus its list/article/community pages (places-to-stay, beachfront, motels-inns, best-boutique-hotels, romantic, green, dog-friendly, new-hotels-fresh-renovations), which exposed profile ids missing from the truncated sitemap; (3) OpenStreetMap via Nominatim category searches ([hotel] [motel] [guest house] [resort] …) over ten boxes along the barrier islands (~185 features), used both for discovery and for coordinates; (4) operator portfolios: Opal Collection, TradeWinds, Plaza Beach Resorts, St. Pete Beach Boutique Hotel Collection (PAG), Provident Resorts, Sunsational Beach Rentals, Clearwater Beach Collection, Travel Resort Services, the Bay & Beach Club group, Coastal Collection; (5) status sources: HVS "From Recovery to Reinvestment" (Jul 1, 2026), Bay News 9 (Sep 16, 2025), Visit St. Pete-Clearwater new-hotels list (Aug 2026); (6) guessed domains for OSM-only motels (found Suncoast Beach Villas and John's Pass Beach Motel). The session's WebSearch quota was exhausted early by other agents, so discovery relied on these lists.

**Sourcing:** each record's own site was read (curl with a browser UA, or WebFetch) whenever reachable; 99 records carry a verbatim quote, and every quote from a curl-readable page was machine-checked against the page text. marriott.com, hilton.com, hyatt.com and ihg.com block automated reading, so 26 records use the Visit St. Pete-Clearwater profile and 6 the chamber listing as source_url (noted per record). Room counts are set only when the hotel's own page states them (third-party counts are in notes). Features only from the hotel's page unless a note says otherwise. Coordinates: 86 OSM features (geo_source osm), 45 Census address matches, 3 official (site JSON-LD); every Census match was re-checked for city.
